reconstruction_summary: Re-ran agent's V5 ('tuned') model: per-platform KS with lag-shifted delta, refit steering-ratio k, linear understeer K*v^2 denominator, and bias subtraction; coefficients taken from out/shapley.json fits_full.
notes: Globbed all 545 canonical Ford sim.csv files; used 521. Baseline recomputation matches canonical V0 to ~1e-9. V5 combined fits sourced verbatim from agent's out/shapley.json (per-platform), with wheelbase L from agent's tools/final_eval.py.
